name: Entities by type
description: Count graph entities grouped by their SuccessFactors entity type.
cypher: MATCH (n:SFEntity) RETURN n.entityType AS entityType, count(n) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT $limit

name: Reporting lines
description: Approved REPORTS_TO relationships between synthetic or imported entities.
cypher: MATCH (e:SFEntity)-[r:REPORTS_TO]->(m:SFEntity) RETURN e.entityType AS sourceType, e.sourceKey AS sourceKey, m.entityType AS targetType, m.sourceKey AS targetKey, r.mappingId AS mappingId LIMIT $limit

name: Effective-dated jobs
description: Job rows preserved as separate graph nodes, including historical effective dates.
cypher: MATCH (n:SFEntity {entityType: $entityType}) RETURN n.sourceKey AS sourceKey, n.effectiveStart AS effectiveStart, n.effectiveEnd AS effectiveEnd, n.displayLabel AS displayLabel ORDER BY n.sourceKey LIMIT $limit

name: Approved relationships
description: Business relationships created from approved mappings.
cypher: MATCH (a:SFEntity)-[r]->(b:SFEntity) WHERE type(r) IN ['REPORTS_TO', 'BELONGS_TO', 'OCCUPIES', 'HAS_EMPLOYMENT', 'HAS_JOB', 'ASSIGNED_TO', 'RELATED_TO'] RETURN type(r) AS relationshipType, a.entityType AS sourceType, a.sourceKey AS sourceKey, b.entityType AS targetType, b.sourceKey AS targetKey, r.mappingId AS mappingId LIMIT $limit
